propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate has been Staff Software Engineer for a cloud software company's observability platform since 2022, setting the platform's technical direction across its ingestion, storage and query teams, after a senior software engineer role on the storage team from 2018 to 2022.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the work sample document the staff role and the periods.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate wrote the platform's technical strategy for 2023 and 2025 and the fourteen architecture decision records the three teams built against, chaired the platform design review from 2022, and represented the platform in the company's technical steering group.
propositions.rationale: The resume, the strategy, the records and the steering group minutes document the authorship, the review chair and the representation.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate coached the five senior engineers across the three teams under the engineering coaching practice and wrote the open questions section of each decision record and the boundary note of each design review.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the work sample document the coaching and the open questions sections.

expectedGap: None; the materials document the staff role, the strategy and decision records, the design review chair, the steering group representation and the coaching.
expectedBoundaryNote: The staff role and the record authorship are documented in the resume, the repository and the steering group minutes; the senior engineer years are shown separately.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the architecture repository references of the fourteen records to confirm the author fields.
